title: Three-Dimensional Wake Reconstruction and Cross-Scale Transfer for Floating Offshore Wind Turbines via Physics-Informed Fourier Neural Operators
abstract: arXiv:2611.31789v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coupled surge-pitch motions drive unsteady vortex interactions and dynamic wake meandering behind floating offshore wind turbines, complicating three-dimensional wake reconstruction from limited measurements and transfer across turbine scales. Large-eddy simulations coupled with an actuator line model generate fixed and surge-pitch wakes at motion-based Strouhal numbers $St=fD/U_\infty$ of 0.2-0.6 (where $f$, $D$, and $U_\infty$ are the motion frequency, rotor diameter, and inflow velocity) for the National Renewable Energy Laboratory 5 MW ($D=126$ m) and International Energy Agency 22 MW ($D=284$ m) turbines. A physics-informed Fourier neural operator framework combines four-dimensional spectral convolutions with incompressible continuity and rotor-forced momentum-residual regularization to reconstruct three-dimensional unsteady wakes from two observation planes. translated_title: 基于物理信息傅里叶神经算子的浮式海上风力机三维尾流重建与跨尺度迁移
translated_abstract: 浮式海上风力机的纵荡-俯仰耦合运动会引发非定常涡相互作用和动态尾流摆动，这使得基于有限测量数据的三维尾流重建以及跨风机尺度的迁移变得困难。研究采用大涡模拟耦合致动线模型，针对美国国家可再生能源实验室（NREL）5兆瓦风机（D=126米）和国际能源署（IEA）22兆瓦风机（D=284米），在基于运动的斯特劳哈尔数 St=fD/U∞（其中f、D和U∞分别为运动频率、转子直径和来流速度）为0.2-0.6的条件下，生成了固定式和纵荡-俯仰运动状态下的尾流数据。物理信息傅里叶神经算子框架将四维谱卷积与不可压缩连续性约束及转子强迫动量残差正则化相结合，从两个观测平面重建三维非定常尾流。该框架在5兆瓦固定式和St=0.2-0.5工况数据上训练，能够恢复……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出物理信息傅里叶神经算子框架，将四维谱卷积与不可压缩连续性及动量残差等物理约束相结合，可从两个观测平面重建浮式海上风力机的三维非定常尾流，并实现从5兆瓦到22兆瓦风机的跨尺度迁移。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a physics-informed Fourier neural operator framework combining 4D spectral convolutions with incompressibility and momentum-residual constraints to reconstruct 3D unsteady wakes of floating offshore wind turbines from only two observation planes and enable cross-scale transfer from 5 MW to 22 MW turbines.
